lauramod.help.title: My Girlfriend Laura: main commands
lauramod.help.summon: /laura summon, or say "I feel lonely" in chat, or use Laura's Heart
lauramod.help.orders: /laura follow | stay | wander | come | stop | sleep | wakeup
lauramod.help.fetch: /laura fetch <item> [count] [queue], or say "bring me some bread"
lauramod.help.tasks: /laura chop | harvest | cook [radius], /laura queue list | clear | remove <n>
lauramod.help.jobs: /laura job lumberjack | farmer | cook [radius], /laura job stop
lauramod.help.chests: /laura chest <purpose> while looking at a chest, /laura chest list
lauramod.help.chat: Talk to her in chat within 64 blocks. Chain orders with "then". Press K for her menu.
lauramod.release.confirm: This cannot be undone: %s will leave for good and drop her belongings. Type /laura release confirm to go ahead.
lauramod.upload.quota: You already keep %s files of this kind on the server. Replace one of them (same file name) or ask an admin to remove one.
lauramod.upload.bbmodel_only: Only .bbmodel files can be sent from here (they hold their textures). Put .geo.json models in the server folder config/lauramod/models.
